method.value: Convert cubes to velocity; single-Gaussian fit per pixel with AIPS XGAUS, rejecting poor fits

evidence.quote: The best velocity fields were found using the single Gaussian fitter in the AIPS task XGAUS.

method.value: Ring width between beam minor-axis FWHM/3 and /2; flat warp-less disk

evidence.quote: an upper limit of the full width at half maximum (FWHM) of the minor axis of the synthesized beam divided by three and a lower limit of the FWHM of the minor axis of the synthesized beam divided by two

assumptions.value: constant inclination and position angle, circular rotation

evidence.quote: we will assume a constant inclination and position angle across each disk

method.value: ROTCUR with two sets of initial estimates (RC1 by eye, GAUS from Gaussian fits) and all ring-number combinations (96 runs); fix centre, then vsys, then phi and i, finally fit only vc

evidence.quote: By varying both parameter estimates and ring number, we thus consider the results of $16\times6=96$ full runs.

key_parameters.value: success: vc>3 dvc, d i<50 deg, d phi<50 deg

evidence.quote: Success is defined as: $v_{\rm c}>3\times\delta v_{\rm c}$, $\delta i<50^{\circ}$, and $\delta \phi<50^{\circ}$

fitting.value: Least-squares ROTCUR; vc uncertainty is max of ROTCUR error, channel width, and vc|sin i - sin(i±di)|

evidence.quote: The uncertainty in rotational velocity for each ring is estimated as the maximum of the uncertainty by ROTCUR for that ring, the velocity width of a channel

validation.value: Model velocity field from VELFI subtracted from data; normalized residual

evidence.quote: The residual velocity values for each pixel are added in quadrature and normalized by the number of pixels

method.value: M_dyn = v^2 r / G at largest ring and per ring; dark matter by subtracting dust, stellar and H2 mass
